en.title: String After Repeatedly Deleting AWS
en.description:
Repeatedly delete the contiguous substring AWS from the string until no more deletions are possible, and output the remaining string; output -1 if it is empty.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a string of uppercase English letters, 1≤length≤100000.
en.output: Output the final string; output -1 if it is empty.
en.explanation: The examples give G, -1 and XYZ respectively.
hints: Push characters onto a stack one by one, and whenever the top of the stack is exactly AWS, delete those three characters.
